content.comment_body: Hello, Most people now use Microsoft Office 365. Is it possible to use [product_name] v2.0 with Microsoft Office 365 Excel?
No. Please refer to this topic: On the Add-in tab, the [product_name] menu does not appear. You can also check the official support statement for further details.

analysis.insight_summary: Users asked about compatibility between [product_name] v2.0 and Microsoft Office 365 Excel. Responses confirmed it does not work, highlighting the lack of integration with the current Office 365 Excel and affecting those who have updated their Microsoft Office.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] v2.0 to function smoothly with Microsoft Office 365 Excel, maintaining the same features and usability found in older versions.
